title: Wikipedia: Rubric (academic)
summary: Describes a scoring rubric as a set of criteria, each with levels of quality and a descriptor for each level. Motivates GR02 (evidence for one criterion at a time), GR07 (whether adjacent level descriptors state a boundary), and the per-criterion framing of GR01 and GR05. Motivation for the patterns, not evidence of Jev performance.

title: GOV.UK: Reducing teacher workload: Marking Policy Review Group report
summary: A government review group's report on reducing the workload of marking, setting out that effective marking should be meaningful, manageable, and motivating. Motivates GR03 (whether a comment gives the student something to do) and the collection's aim of directing a teacher's reading time; also the reading-order use of GR01, GR05, and GR08. Motivation, not evidence of Jev performance.

title: Wikipedia: Paraphrase
summary: Defines a paraphrase as a restatement of a text in other words that keeps its meaning, as distinct from quotation. Motivates GR06 as a reading of the wording and structure relation between a student passage and a source passage; the acceptability decision stays with the teacher. Motivation, not evidence of Jev performance.

title: Wikipedia: Citation
summary: Describes a citation as an in-text reference that points to an entry in a work's reference list and surveys parenthetical and note-based systems. Motivates GR04 as a check for whether quoted material carries such a reference; format rules and reference-list matching stay in code. Motivation, not evidence of Jev performance.

title: UNC Writing Center: Conclusions
summary: A university writing center handout on what a conclusion should do for a reader, with strategies to avoid such as ending on a rephrased thesis with nothing added or introducing a new idea or subtopic in the conclusion. Motivates GR08 (concludes, restates only, or introduces new material) and the on-topic framing of GR01. Motivation, not evidence of Jev performance.
